entities.name: Lactam-to-amine reduction
observations: Reactant standardizes to CN1C[C@@H]2c3ccccc3Oc3ccc(Cl)cc3[C@H]2C1=O; product is the corresponding C1 methylene tertiary amine.
The net transformation is cyclic lactam/amide carbonyl reduction to a methylene, not sulfur-bound oxygen removal.

entities.name: Aluminum hydride lactam reduction
observations: Matching ORD records use aluminum-hydride chemistry consistent with LiAlH4/related aluminum hydride species, in THF/toluene at 0 °C for 1 hour, followed by NaOH/water workup.
Reported yield is 99% in the matching records.

entities.name: Lithium aluminum hydride
observations: Strong candidate reagent for reducing a cyclic lactam carbonyl to the corresponding cyclic tertiary amine.
Supported by matching ORD records containing lithium, aluminum, hydride, and chloride components, with THF/toluene solvent and aqueous basic workup.
